recipes.name: Beef Tagine with Prunes
recipes.description: Sweet-savory Moroccan celebration dish: beef braised with prunes, cinnamon and toasted almonds.

steps.instruction: Cook beef with grated onion, spices and oil; add water to half-cover.
Cover and simmer 75 minutes until tender.
Add prunes, honey and cinnamon; reduce to a glossy sauce.
Serve scattered with almonds over bread or couscous.

recipes.name: Kefta Mkaouara
recipes.description: Spiced meatballs bubbling in cumin-tomato sauce - street-side Casablanca comfort.

steps.instruction: Season meat; roll small balls.
Simmer sauce with spices 10 minutes; slip in meatballs.
Cook covered 20 minutes; crack eggs over if using.
Rest until eggs set; shower with herbs.

videos.videoTitle: Kefta Mkaouara (Moroccan Meatballs in Tomato Sauce) Recipe

recipes.name: Couscous Tfaya with Beef
recipes.description: Friday couscous crowned with caramelized onion-raisin tfaya over fall-apart beef.

steps.instruction: Braise beef with ras el hanout, chickpeas and water until tender.
Steam couscous twice over the pot for fluff.
Cook onions with raisins, honey and cinnamon into jammy tfaya.
Mound couscous, add beef, blanket with tfaya and its syrup.

videos.videoTitle: Couscous au bœuf et tfaya, un classique plein de saveurs ! 🥙

recipes.name: Beef Briouat Triangles
recipes.description: Crisp warqa triangles stuffed with spiced minced beef, fried gold and honey-kissed.

steps.instruction: Brown beef with onion, herbs and spices; cool slightly; bind with yolks.
Fold spoonfuls into tight triangles.
Fry at 175°C until deep gold; drain.
Dip edges in honey and sprinkle sesame.

videos.videoTitle: BRIOUATES BOEUF HACHÉ & VERMICELLES ✨Recette Spécial Ramadan 🎋Faciles rapide | Briouate Kefta Recipe

recipes.name: Kefta Tagine with Egg
recipes.description: Spiced ground beef simmered in a rich tomato sauce topped with poached eggs

steps.instruction: Brown the ground beef with cumin, paprika, and salt in a skillet
Add diced onion and garlic, cook until softened
Stir in chopped tomatoes and tomato paste, simmer 15 minutes
Make wells in the sauce and crack eggs into them
Cover and cook until eggs are set, about 5 minutes
Garnish with cilantro and parsley, serve with bread

videos.videoTitle: Easy Moroccan Kefta Tagine with Eggs | Authentic Recipe

recipes.name: Mechoui Slow-Roasted Lamb
recipes.description: Whole lamb shoulder slow-roasted with cumin, butter, and salt until fall-off-the-bone tender

steps.instruction: Mix softened butter with cumin, salt, pepper, garlic, and saffron
Rub the spiced butter all over the lamb shoulder
Place in a clay pot or roasting pan, add water to the bottom
Cover tightly and slow-roast at 160C for 3-4 hours
Uncover for the last 30 minutes to brown the exterior
Shred the meat with forks and serve with cooking juices

videos.videoTitle: Quick and Easy Moroccan Mechoui Lamb

recipes.name: Grilled Beef Brochettes
recipes.description: Marinated beef cubes grilled on skewers with bell peppers and onions

steps.instruction: Mix olive oil, lemon juice, cumin, paprika, garlic, salt, and pepper for marinade
Toss beef cubes in marinade and refrigerate for at least 1 hour
Thread beef, peppers, and onions onto metal skewers
Grill over medium-high heat for 3-4 minutes per side
Serve with warm bread and harissa on the side

videos.videoTitle: Beef Brochette Recipe by Chef Mehboob Khan | Juicy & Easy Homemade BBQ | Masala TV

recipes.name: Spicy Merguez Sausage
recipes.description: Homemade spicy lamb and beef sausages seasoned with harissa and cumin

steps.instruction: Combine ground lamb and beef with all spices and harissa
Mix well until the mixture becomes sticky
Stuff into casings using a sausage stuffer
Grill over medium heat for 12-15 minutes, turning frequently
Serve in crusty bread with mustard and harissa

recipes.name: Beef Pastilla
recipes.description: Flaky pastry filled with spiced beef, eggs, and almonds dusted with cinnamon and sugar

steps.instruction: Braise diced beef with onion, saffron, ginger, turmeric, and salt until tender
Add broth and simmer until sauce thickens
Scramble eggs into the sauce and let cool
Layer warqa sheets in a round pan, brush with butter
Fill with beef-egg mixture, top with crushed almonds
Fold pastry over, bake at 180C until golden
Dust with powdered sugar and cinnamon before serving

recipes.name: Tangia Marrakesh
recipes.description: Slow-cooked spiced beef shank traditionally prepared in an amphora at the hammam oven

steps.instruction: Season beef shank with saffron, cumin, ras el hanout, garlic, and salt
Place in a clay amphora or deep pot
Add preserved lemons, smen, olive oil, and cilantro
Pour in water and seal the top with foil
Cook in a low oven at 140C for 4-5 hours until meat is tender
Serve directly from the pot with crusty bread

videos.videoTitle: Slow Cook Tangia Marrakchia Authentic Recipe

recipes.name: Beef Kofta in Tomato Sauce
recipes.description: Grilled beef kofta patties served in a warm spiced tomato and pepper sauce

steps.instruction: Mix ground beef with grated onion, parsley, cumin, paprika, egg, salt, and pepper
Shape into oval patties and grill until charred on both sides
Sauté diced pepper and garlic in olive oil until soft
Add chopped tomatoes and tomato paste, simmer 10 minutes
Place grilled kofta in the sauce and simmer 5 more minutes
Serve with couscous or bread

recipes.name: Harira with Beef
recipes.description: Hearty Moroccan soup with beef, lentils, chickpeas, and tomatoes thickened with flour

steps.instruction: Brown diced beef in olive oil with onion until sealed
Add water, tomatoes, tomato paste, celery, and all spices
Bring to a boil then simmer for 30 minutes
Add lentils and chickpeas, cook 15 more minutes
Stir in flour-water mixture and simmer until thickened
Finish with fresh herbs and lemon juice, serve hot

recipes.name: Beef with Preserved Lemons
recipes.description: Tender beef chunks braised with preserved lemons, olives, and aromatic spices

steps.instruction: Season beef with ginger, turmeric, saffron, and salt
Brown in olive oil on all sides in a heavy pot
Add sliced onion and garlic, cook 3 minutes
Add water, bring to boil, then cover and simmer 1.5 hours
Add preserved lemons and olives, cook 15 more minutes
Garnish with cilantro and serve with couscous

recipes.name: Beef Mrouzia
recipes.description: Sweet and savory slow-cooked beef with ras el hanout, honey, and raisins for Eid celebrations

steps.instruction: Marinate beef with ras el hanout, cinnamon, ginger, saffron, and salt
Brown in olive oil with smen in a heavy pot
Add sliced onions and garlic, cook until softened
Add water, bring to boil, then simmer covered for 2 hours
Add honey, raisins, and almonds, cook 20 more minutes
Serve warm with bread or couscous

recipes.name: Beef Tagine with Apricots
recipes.description: Tender beef braised with dried apricots, caramelized onions, and warming spices

steps.instruction: Season beef with cinnamon, ginger, turmeric, saffron, and salt
Brown in olive oil in a tagine or heavy pot
Add onions and cook until deeply caramelized
Add water, cover, and simmer for 2 hours
Add apricots and honey, cook 20 minutes more
Top with almonds and serve with couscous

recipes.name: Classic Beef Couscous
recipes.description: Traditional Friday couscous with tender beef, seasonal vegetables, and a rich spiced broth

steps.instruction: Place beef, onion, turmeric, ginger, saffron, and cinnamon in a large pot with water
Bring to boil, skim foam, then simmer for 1 hour
Add chickpeas, carrots, and turnips, cook 20 minutes
Add zucchini and pumpkin, cook 15 more minutes
Steam couscous with butter and broth in a couscoussier
Mound couscous on a platter, top with meat and vegetables, ladle broth over

recipes.name: Beef and Vegetable Tagine
recipes.description: Hearty beef tagine loaded with seasonal vegetables and fragrant spices

steps.instruction: Brown beef in olive oil until seared on all sides
Add onion and garlic, cook 3 minutes
Add tomatoes, cumin, paprika, ginger, and salt
Add water and simmer covered for 1.5 hours
Add potatoes and carrots, cook 20 minutes
Add zucchini and peas, cook 15 more minutes, garnish with cilantro

recipes.name: Beef Tagine with Cinnamon and Honey
recipes.description: Aromatic beef braised with cinnamon, honey, and toasted sesame seeds

steps.instruction: Season beef with ginger, turmeric, saffron, salt, and pepper
Brown in olive oil with cinnamon sticks
Add onions and cook until golden, about 8 minutes
Add water, bring to boil, then simmer covered for 2 hours
Drizzle with honey and simmer 10 more minutes
Toast sesame seeds, sprinkle over top, and serve with bread

recipes.name: Beef Tagine with Almonds
recipes.description: Slow-braised beef topped with crispy fried almonds and a fragrant sauce

steps.instruction: Brown beef in olive oil until well-colored on all sides
Add grated onion, garlic, ginger, saffron, turmeric, and salt
Add water and simmer covered for 2 hours until very tender
Fry almonds in olive oil until golden, drain on paper towels
Hard-boil eggs and slice in half
Arrange beef on platter, top with eggs, fried almonds, powdered sugar, and cinnamon

recipes.name: Beef Tagine with Olives
recipes.description: Tender beef braised with cracked green olives, preserved lemons, and herbs

steps.instruction: Season beef with cumin, paprika, ginger, saffron, and salt
Brown in olive oil in a tagine or heavy pot
Add onion and garlic, cook until softened
Add water and simmer covered for 1.5 hours
Add olives and preserved lemons, cook 15 more minutes
Finish with fresh herbs and serve with couscous or bread

recipes.name: Chicken Tagine with Preserved Lemon & Olives
recipes.description: The definitive Moroccan tagine: saffron chicken under preserved lemon and purple olives.

steps.instruction: Rub chicken with spices, herbs, garlic and oil; rest 1 hour.
Nestle into tagine with onions; add water a finger deep.
Cook covered low ~55 minutes.
Add lemon rind and olives; reduce sauce 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Chicken Bastilla
recipes.description: Sweet-savory pie: crisp warqa around shredded chicken, eggs, almonds and cinnamon sugar.

steps.instruction: Stew chicken with onions and spices; shred; reduce liquid with beaten eggs to a thick scramble.
Layer buttered pastry rounds in a wide pan.
Fill with egg layer then chicken then almond crunch; cap with more pastry.
Bake 180°C ~30 min; dust heavily with powdered sugar lines.

recipes.name: Rfissa
recipes.description: Shredded msemen drowned in fenugreek-ras el hanout chicken broth - postpartum and celebration food.

steps.instruction: Simmer chicken with fenugreek, lentils, spices and onions till tender.
Warm shredded msemen through the steam above the broth.
Pile bread on platter; drown with broth.
Top with chicken pieces, lentils and onions.

recipes.name: Grilled Chermoula Chicken
recipes.description: Chermoula-marinated chicken off the charcoal - summer souks in a bite.

ingredients.name: Chermoula Marinade
ingredients.note: coriander, parsley, garlic, paprika, cumin, lemon, oil

steps.instruction: Marinate chicken minimum 4 hours.
Grill skin-side down over medium coals 15 minutes; flip.
Finish indirect until juices run clear.
Rest; serve with extra chermoula.

recipes.name: Chicken Tangia
recipes.description: Slow-cooked chicken with saffron, smen, and spices in a traditional clay pot

steps.instruction: Rub chicken with saffron, cumin, garlic, ginger, and salt
Place in a clay pot or deep oven-safe dish
Add smen, preserved lemons, cilantro, and olive oil
Pour in water and cover tightly with foil
Cook at 150C for 3 hours until falling off the bone
Serve directly from the pot with bread

recipes.name: Chicken Rfissa
recipes.description: Shredded msemen bread topped with spiced chicken and a rich lentil-fenugreek sauce

steps.instruction: Boil fenugreek seeds in water overnight or at least 4 hours
Brown chicken with onion, saffron, turmeric, ginger, and ras el hanout
Add water and simmer for 1 hour until chicken is cooked through
Add lentils to the broth and cook 20 minutes
Tear msemen into pieces and arrange on a platter
Ladle broth and lentils over bread, place chicken on top

recipes.name: Chicken Kefta Skewers
recipes.description: Minced chicken kefta with herbs and spices grilled on skewers

steps.instruction: Combine ground chicken with grated onion, herbs, spices, egg, salt, and pepper
Mix well until mixture is smooth and holds shape
Form into small oval shapes around metal skewers
Brush with olive oil and grill over medium-high heat
Cook 4-5 minutes per side until lightly charred
Serve with salad and warm bread

recipes.name: Chicken Saffron Tagine
recipes.description: Tender chicken pieces braised with saffron, ginger, and preserved lemons

steps.instruction: Season chicken with saffron, ginger, salt, and pepper
Brown in olive oil in a tagine until golden
Add onions and garlic, cook 5 minutes
Add water, cover, and simmer for 45 minutes
Add preserved lemons, cook 10 more minutes
Garnish with cilantro and serve with bread or couscous

recipes.name: Chicken Tagine with Dried Fruits
recipes.description: Sweet and savory chicken braised with apricots, prunes, and warming spices

steps.instruction: Season chicken with cinnamon, ginger, saffron, and salt
Brown in olive oil until golden on both sides
Add sliced onion, cook 5 minutes
Add water and simmer covered for 40 minutes
Add dried fruits and honey, cook 15 more minutes
Garnish with almonds and serve with couscous

recipes.name: Djaj Mqualli
recipes.description: Classic Moroccan chicken tagine with a bright yellow saffron and ginger sauce

steps.instruction: Season chicken with saffron, ginger, turmeric, garlic, and salt
Brown in olive oil in a heavy pot
Add grated onions, cilantro, and parsley
Add water and simmer covered for 45 minutes
Reduce sauce if needed until thick and golden
Finish with lemon juice and serve with couscous

recipes.name: Chicken Tagine with Turnips
recipes.description: Chicken braised with turnips and carrots in a light saffron broth

steps.instruction: Season chicken with saffron, ginger, turmeric, and salt
Brown in olive oil until golden
Add onion, cook 3 minutes
Add water and simmer covered for 30 minutes
Add turnips and carrots, cook 25 minutes more
Garnish with cilantro and serve with bread

recipes.name: Chicken with Artichokes
recipes.description: Tender chicken braised with artichoke hearts, peas, and a lemony sauce

steps.instruction: Season chicken with saffron, ginger, and salt
Brown in olive oil in a tagine
Add onion and garlic, cook 3 minutes
Add water and simmer covered for 30 minutes
Add artichoke hearts and peas, cook 20 minutes more
Finish with lemon juice and cilantro, serve with bread

recipes.name: Chicken Tagine with Peas
recipes.description: Chicken braised with tender green peas and a light herb sauce

steps.instruction: Season chicken with saffron, ginger, turmeric, and salt
Brown in olive oil until golden
Add onion and garlic, cook until softened
Add water and simmer covered for 35 minutes
Add peas and cook 15 minutes more
Finish with herbs and lemon juice, serve with couscous

recipes.name: Chicken M'hammar
recipes.description: Crispy fried chicken marinated in garlic, paprika, and saffron

steps.instruction: Marinate chicken with garlic, paprika, saffron, cumin, turmeric, salt, and pepper
Let marinate for at least 2 hours in the refrigerator
Heat olive oil in a deep pan over medium heat
Fry chicken pieces until golden and crispy, about 15 minutes per side
Drain on paper towels
Squeeze lemon juice over top and serve with french fries

recipes.name: Chicken with Almonds
recipes.description: Braised chicken served with a generous topping of crispy fried almonds

steps.instruction: Season chicken with saffron, ginger, turmeric, and salt
Brown in olive oil until golden
Add grated onion and garlic, cook 3 minutes
Add water and simmer covered for 45 minutes
Fry almonds in oil until golden, drain on paper towels
Arrange chicken on platter, top with almonds, powdered sugar, and cinnamon

recipes.name: Chicken Herb Tagine
recipes.description: Chicken braised with fresh herbs, olives, and a bright lemon sauce

steps.instruction: Season chicken with cumin, ginger, and salt
Brown in olive oil until golden on all sides
Add onion and garlic, cook 3 minutes
Add water and simmer covered for 40 minutes
Add olives, herbs, and lemon juice, cook 10 more minutes
Serve with warm bread or couscous

recipes.name: Chicken with Honey and Walnuts
recipes.description: Sweet and savory chicken tagine with honey, walnuts, and warm spices

steps.instruction: Season chicken with cinnamon, ginger, saffron, and salt
Brown in olive oil until golden
Add sliced onion, cook until softened
Add water and simmer covered for 40 minutes
Add honey, walnuts, and prunes, cook 15 minutes more
Serve with couscous or bread

recipes.name: Chicken Vegetable Tagine
recipes.description: Chicken braised with a medley of fresh vegetables in a light spiced broth

steps.instruction: Brown chicken in olive oil until golden
Add onion and garlic, cook 3 minutes
Add tomatoes, cumin, paprika, and salt
Add water and simmer covered for 30 minutes
Add potatoes and carrots, cook 15 minutes
Add zucchini and peas, cook 10 more minutes, garnish with cilantro

recipes.name: Chicken Mechoui
recipes.description: Whole chicken marinated in a spiced butter paste and slow-roasted until golden

steps.instruction: Mix softened butter with cumin, paprika, garlic, saffron, salt, and pepper
Rub the spiced butter all over and under the chicken skin
Tie legs together and tuck wings
Roast at 180C for 1.5 hours, basting occasionally
Increase heat to 200C for the last 15 minutes to crisp the skin
Rest 10 minutes before carving, serve with cooking juices

recipes.name: Chicken and Merguez Tagine
recipes.description: Chicken braised with spicy merguez sausage, tomatoes, and peppers

steps.instruction: Brown chicken pieces in olive oil until golden
Remove chicken, brown merguez slices in the same pan
Add onion, pepper, and garlic, cook 5 minutes
Add tomatoes and tomato paste, simmer 5 minutes
Return chicken to pan, add water, cover and cook 35 minutes
Garnish with cilantro and serve with bread

recipes.name: Zaalouk
recipes.description: Silky cooked eggplant-tomato salad with garlic, cumin and parsley - mezze table staple.

steps.instruction: Fry eggplant in oil until collapsing.
Add tomatoes, garlic, spices; simmer 20 minutes stirring.
Cook down until spreadable; finish with parsley and lemon.

recipes.name: Taktouka
recipes.description: Roasted pepper and tomato dip, softly spiced - the other half of every Moroccan bread basket.

steps.instruction: Char peppers; peel and cut into fine strips.
Reduce tomatoes with garlic and spices 20 minutes.
Fold peppers through; cook 5 more; serve warm or cold.

recipes.name: Bissara
recipes.description: Velvety split-fava soup/dip with olive oil, cumin and paprika - Fassi dawn fuel.

steps.instruction: Simmer fava with garlic until completely soft (~35 min).
Blend smooth with cooking water to pouring cream consistency.
Season; serve pooled with oil, cumin, paprika and lemon.

recipes.name: Vegetarian Seven-Vegetable Couscous
recipes.description: Friday couscous without the meat: pumpkin, turnips, carrots, zucchini, cabbage and chickpeas over steamed grains.

steps.instruction: Build a spiced vegetable broth; cook hardy veg first, tender last.
Steam couscous twice over the broth until fluffy.
Butter and fluff the grains; season broth well.
Mound couscous; arrange vegetables; ladle broth generously.

recipes.name: Harira Soup
recipes.description: Classic Moroccan tomato and lentil soup with chickpeas thickened with flour and fresh herbs

steps.instruction: Sauté onion and celery in olive oil until softened
Add tomatoes, tomato paste, and spices, cook 5 minutes
Add water, chickpeas, and lentils, bring to a boil
Simmer for 30 minutes until lentils are tender
Stir in flour-water mixture and simmer until thickened
Finish with fresh herbs and lemon juice, serve hot

videos.videoTitle: How to make an authentic Moroccan Harira

recipes.name: Msemen Flatbread
recipes.description: Crispy pan-fried Moroccan flatbread layers brushed with butter and semolina

steps.instruction: Mix semolina, flour, yeast, sugar, and salt
Add warm water and knead into a soft dough, rest 30 minutes
Divide dough into 8 balls
Flatten each ball and spread with butter and oil mixture
Fold into a square shape and flatten gently
Cook on a hot griddle until golden and crispy on both sides

recipes.name: Baghrir Pancakes
recipes.description: Spongy thousand-hole Moroccan pancakes traditionally served with honey and butter

steps.instruction: Blend semolina, flour, yeast, baking powder, sugar, salt, and water until smooth
Let batter rest for 15 minutes until bubbly
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat
Pour batter from the center and swirl to coat
Cook only one side until holes form and surface is dry, about 2 minutes
Serve warm with melted butter and honey

recipes.name: Vegetarian Rfissa
recipes.description: Msemen bread soaked in a spiced lentil and fenugreek broth, a meatless version of the classic

steps.instruction: Soak fenugreek seeds in water overnight or at least 4 hours
Sauté onion in olive oil with turmeric, ginger, saffron, and ras el hanout
Add water and fenugreek water, bring to a boil
Add lentils and simmer for 25 minutes until tender
Tear msemen into pieces and arrange on a platter
Ladle the hot broth and lentils over the bread, garnish with cilantro

recipes.name: Moroccan Lentil Soup
recipes.description: Hearty spiced lentil soup with cumin, turmeric, and fresh lemon

steps.instruction: Sauté onion, carrot, and celery in olive oil until softened
Add garlic, cumin, turmeric, and paprika, cook 1 minute
Add lentils and water, bring to a boil
Simmer for 25 minutes until lentils are very soft
Blend half the soup for a creamier texture or leave chunky
Finish with lemon juice and cilantro, serve hot

recipes.name: Chickpea Tagine
recipes.description: Hearty vegetarian tagine with chickpeas, dried fruits, and warming spices

steps.instruction: Sauté onion in olive oil until golden
Add garlic, cumin, cinnamon, ginger, and turmeric, cook 1 minute
Add tomatoes and chickpeas, stir well
Add water and simmer covered for 25 minutes
Add dried fruits and honey, cook 10 more minutes
Garnish with cilantro and serve with couscous or bread

recipes.name: Spiced Carrot Salad
recipes.description: Cooked carrots tossed with cumin, paprika, garlic, and fresh herbs

steps.instruction: Boil or steam carrot slices until tender, about 10 minutes
Drain and let cool slightly
Toss with olive oil, lemon juice, cumin, paprika, garlic, and salt
Add fresh herbs and toss gently
Serve at room temperature or chilled as a side salad

recipes.name: Moroccan Beet Salad
recipes.description: Tender boiled beets dressed with cumin, garlic, olive oil, and fresh herbs

steps.instruction: Boil whole beets until tender, about 45 minutes
Peel and dice the cooked beets
Toss with olive oil, lemon juice, cumin, garlic, salt, and pepper
Add fresh herbs and toss gently
Serve chilled or at room temperature as a side dish

recipes.name: Vegetable Tagine
recipes.description: Colorful tagine with seasonal vegetables, chickpeas, and fragrant spices

steps.instruction: Sauté onion in olive oil until softened
Add garlic, cumin, paprika, ginger, and turmeric
Add tomatoes and cook 3 minutes
Add potatoes, carrots, pumpkin, and water
Simmer covered for 25 minutes, then add zucchini and peas
Cook 15 more minutes, garnish with cilantro, serve with couscous

recipes.name: Batbout Pan Bread
recipes.description: Soft Moroccan pan-baked bread with a pillowy interior, perfect for stuffing

steps.instruction: Mix flour, semolina, yeast, sugar, and salt
Add olive oil and warm water, knead until smooth and elastic
Cover and let rise for 1 hour until doubled
Divide into small balls and flatten into discs
Cook on a hot dry griddle, pressing gently to puff
Serve warm, split open and filled with fillings of choice

recipes.name: Moroccan Shakshuka
recipes.description: Eggs poached in a spicy tomato and pepper sauce with cumin and paprika

steps.instruction: Sauté onion and pepper in olive oil until soft
Add garlic, cumin, paprika, and cayenne, cook 1 minute
Add tomatoes and tomato paste, simmer 10 minutes until thick
Make wells in the sauce and crack eggs into them
Cover and cook until eggs are just set, about 5 minutes
Garnish with cilantro and serve with bread for dipping

recipes.name: Amlou Almond Dip
recipes.description: Traditional Moroccan dip made from almonds, argan oil, and honey

steps.instruction: Toast almonds in a dry pan until fragrant and golden
Let almonds cool slightly
Blend almonds in a food processor until coarsely ground
Add argan oil, honey, cinnamon, and salt, blend until smooth but textured
Transfer to a bowl and serve with bread for dipping

recipes.name: Eggplant Tagine
recipes.description: Silky eggplant braised with tomatoes, peppers, and aromatic spices

steps.instruction: Salt eggplant cubes and let sit 20 minutes to draw out moisture
Pat dry and fry in olive oil until golden, set aside
Sauté onion and pepper in the same pan until soft
Add garlic, cumin, paprika, ginger, and cook 1 minute
Add tomatoes, tomato paste, and water, simmer 10 minutes
Return eggplant to sauce, cook 10 more minutes, garnish with cilantro

recipes.name: Lentil Tagine
recipes.description: Hearty lentil tagine with caramelized onions, dried fruits, and warm spices

steps.instruction: Sauté sliced onions in olive oil until deeply caramelized
Add cinnamon, cumin, ginger, and turmeric, cook 1 minute
Add lentils and water, bring to a boil
Simmer covered for 25 minutes until lentils are tender
Add dried apricots and raisins, cook 10 more minutes
Garnish with cilantro and serve with bread

recipes.name: Broad Bean Tagine
recipes.description: Fresh broad beans braised with tomatoes, herbs, and a touch of cumin

steps.instruction: Blanch broad beans and remove outer skins if desired
Sauté onion in olive oil until softened
Add garlic, cumin, and paprika, cook 1 minute
Add tomatoes and water, simmer 10 minutes
Add broad beans and cook 15 minutes until tender
Finish with herbs and lemon juice, serve with bread

recipes.name: Pumpkin Tagine
recipes.description: Sweet pumpkin braised with chickpeas, raisins, and warming spices

steps.instruction: Sauté onion in olive oil until golden
Add garlic, cinnamon, cumin, and ginger, cook 1 minute
Add pumpkin and chickpeas, stir to coat with spices
Add water and simmer covered for 20 minutes
Add raisins and honey, cook 10 more minutes
Garnish with cilantro and sesame seeds, serve with bread

recipes.name: Chebakia
recipes.description: Sesame-honey flower pastries fried and soaked in syrup - Ramadan's rose among sweets.

steps.instruction: Knead a firm spiced dough; rest 1 hour.
Roll thin; cut squares; fold into flower shapes.
Fry at 175°C until mahogany; drain briefly.
Soak in warm honey 2 minutes; drain on racks.

videos.videoTitle: [ENG] Moroccan Chebakia (Sesame Cookies) | Flavors of Morocco

recipes.name: Kaab el Ghazal
recipes.description: 'Gazelle horns': delicate orange-blossom almond crescents wrapped in paper-thin dough.

steps.instruction: Knead almonds, sugar, blossom water and cinnamon into a fragrant paste.
Roll wrapper dough tissue-thin; cut ovals.
Enclose almond logs; crimp into crescents.
Bake pale at 165°C ~18 minutes - no color allowed.

recipes.name: Sellou
recipes.description: Nutty Moroccan confection of toasted flour, almonds, sesame, and spices

steps.instruction: Toast flour in a dry pan over low heat until golden and nutty
Toast almonds separately until golden, then chop finely
Toast sesame seeds until golden
Mix toasted flour, almonds, sesame, and spices together
Add melted butter, powdered sugar, and egg, mix until crumbly
Press into a mold or shape into balls, chill before serving

recipes.name: Ghoriba Cookies
recipes.description: Crumbly Moroccan cookies with almonds and a delicate vanilla aroma

steps.instruction: Cream butter and powdered sugar until light and fluffy
Beat in the egg and vanilla extract
Fold in flour, ground almonds, baking powder, and salt
Roll dough into small balls and place on a lined baking tray
Press gently with a fork to flatten slightly
Bake at 170C for 15-18 minutes until pale golden, cool completely

recipes.name: Fekkas
recipes.description: Twice-baked Moroccan biscotti scented with anise and sesame, perfect for dipping

steps.instruction: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, sesame, and anise seeds
Add melted butter, eggs, and orange blossom water, form a dough
Shape into 2 logs and place on a lined baking tray
Bake at 180C for 25 minutes until firm and golden
Let cool 10 minutes, then slice diagonally into thin biscotti
Bake slices again at 160C for 10 minutes per side until crisp

recipes.name: Briouat with Almonds
recipes.description: Crispy triangular pastry filled with sweetened almond paste and dipped in honey

steps.instruction: Mix ground almonds, powdered sugar, cinnamon, and orange blossom water
Add melted butter and form into small logs
Cut pastry into long strips about 5cm wide
Place a log at the corner and fold into triangles
Deep fry in hot oil until golden and crispy
Dip immediately in warm honey and let set on a rack

recipes.name: Sweet Pastilla
recipes.description: Delicate pastry filled with a sweet almond cream, dusted with powdered sugar and cinnamon

steps.instruction: Mix ground almonds, powdered sugar, cinnamon, and orange blossom water
Heat milk and butter, add eggs, and stir until thickened
Combine egg mixture with almond mixture to form a paste
Layer warqa sheets in a round pan, brush with butter
Fill with almond cream, fold pastry over and bake at 180C until golden
Dust generously with powdered sugar and cinnamon, serve warm

recipes.name: Makrout Date Pastries
recipes.description: Semolina cookies filled with spiced date paste and fried until golden

steps.instruction: Mix semolina, flour, butter, sugar, and orange blossom water
Add warm water gradually and knead into a soft dough, rest 30 minutes
Mix date paste with cinnamon and form into thin logs
Roll dough into a large rectangle, place date logs along it
Fold dough over, cut into diamond shapes
Deep fry until golden, then dip in warm honey

recipes.name: M'hanncha Snake Cake
recipes.description: Coiled pastry filled with almond paste, baked until golden, and drizzled with orange blossom syrup

steps.instruction: Mix ground almonds, powdered sugar, cinnamon, and orange blossom water
Add melted butter and form into a long log
Lay out pastry sheets, brush with butter
Place almond log at one edge and roll up tightly
Coil the roll into a spiral snake shape on a baking tray
Brush with egg yolk, bake at 180C for 25 minutes until golden
Drizzle with orange blossom sugar syrup while still warm

recipes.name: Moroccan Semolina Cake
recipes.description: Moist semolina cake soaked in orange blossom syrup, topped with toasted almonds

steps.instruction: Mix semolina, coconut, sugar, baking powder, and vanilla
Add yogurt, melted butter, and eggs, stir until combined
Pour into a greased baking pan and smooth the top
Bake at 180C for 30 minutes until golden
Make syrup by boiling sugar and water, add orange blossom water
Pour warm syrup over warm cake, let absorb, top with almonds
